newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Oct existing home sales fell 1.5 pct - NAR.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Oct existing home sales fell 1.5 pct - NAR.

text.p: Sales of existing U.S. homes fell 1.5 percent in October to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 3.97 million units from a revised 4.03 million units in September, the National Association of Realtors said Monday.
The October sales rate was down 2.5 percent from sales of 4.07 million in October last year.
September sales were revised to a 2.7 percent drop to a seasonally adjusted 4.03 million units. The NAR previously said September sales fell 2.9 percent to 4.02 million units.
Wall Street economists had forecast October sales of 4.0 million units.
